submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 14 (Co0.51Sb0.49) had the highest EQE at 0.024%. The first measurement was index 19 (Sb 0.66), close to trirutile CoSb2O6, because that phase is a known photoanode material. Index 14 was about twice as high as index 19. Index 9, on the Co-rich side, dropped sharply. The best composition is probably between about 0.45 and 0.6 Sb.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.0018%, much lower; Co-rich compositions perform poorly
